scope: Pinned Git objects; lexical structural measurements and source-fragment contracts with service stubs. No host execution, full DLL build, engine equivalence, or measured campaign defect.
metric_definition: Direct children of Assets/CvGameCoreDLL with .cpp/.h/.inl suffix; excludes vendor subdirectories. Physical lines include comments/blanks. Token counts mask comments/literals but do not preprocess conditional compilation or infer runtime call frequency. Selected functions are explicitly enumerated, not all functions.

probes.title: A const strategy getter lazily consumes gameplay randomness
probes.adapter_boundary: Counter stub for getSorenRandNum establishes calls and ordering; it does not emulate CvRandom or demonstrate an actual network desync.

probes.title: Group path accessors reference the shared most-recent host path
probes.adapter_boundary: Single-buffer host stub records SetData/GeneratePath/GetLastNode. Tests DLL wrapper ownership and interleaving contract, not host path costs or a proven faulty game call sequence.

probes.title: A failed ordinary Python event handler leaves mutations and later handlers execute
probes.adapter_boundary: Unchanged dispatcher method runs in Python 3 with a Python-2-compatible has_key adapter; controlled handlers and logging stub. Does not boot BUG, Python 2.4, or the native bridge.
